BOUNDED RESULT THAT IS VALIDLY MEASURED AND INDEPENDENTLY RECOMPUTED (audit claim_ceiling, recomputed_metrics): on the frozen credential-free stdlib substrate with shipped-carrier hashes matching freeze.json (kernel 3a6caf97..., models 338aaf4d..., registry 51fb440d...), the reuse treatment product counter=17 vs B-COLD 18 (L=2) / 19 (L=3) gives ratios 0.9444444444444444 / 0.8947368421052632 (both <1.00) with fetch ratio L3 0.6667 (P1/P3) / 0.5556 (P2); T-REPAIR-LEGACY reproduces the prior regression (product 20 -> 1.1111111111111112 at L=2, 1.0526315789473684 at L=3; M-LEGACY-REGRESSION-REPRODUCED=true); B-COLD success 1.0, B-LITERAL-REPLAY 0.0, B-NO-REPAIR 0.0, NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE stale=false; M-WRITE-SET-MAX=1. This bounded cost evidence makes the prior ~5.3% regression look like removable reuse-accounting overhead ON THIS SUBSTRATE, but it is NOT a validated claim: the strict win depends on the reuse semantics not requiring a re-resolve (T-REPAIR-CONSERVATIVE is exactly 1.00 at L=2), the equal-weight counter is preregistered but not independently defended, the locality/contamination half is unmeasured, and no transfer to real-web agents is shown. No canonical status above EXPERIMENTAL is available: VALIDATED requires a PASS audit (this audit is REVISE / producer_claim_supported=false); PRODUCT_CORE requires the Product lane plus promote_to_product=true (runtime lane, false here); REJECTED is unwarranted because the bounded cost hypothesis is measured and points positive. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED are packet/operational dispositions in v2 and MUST NOT replace the claim's effective epistemic state, so the retained canonical status is EXPERIMENTAL and the packet failure is recorded here, in verdict.reason and in handoff.json.

reason: Frozen design-contract v2 packet, lane=runtime, single frozen claim C-DELTA-REPAIR (present in spec.claim_ids and in the runtime lane charter priority_claims). The independent audit is status=REVISE with producer_claim_supported=false (audit.json:5-6), so the packet cannot license any advance of C-DELTA-REPAIR. Two required_fixes are blocks_claim=true: F1-CONTAMINATION-INSTRUMENT and F2-CONTROL-ATTESTATION. Critical validity findings A1-NC-OVERBROAD-VACUOUS and A2-CONTAMINATION-METRIC-DEGENERATE establish that a preregistered null control (NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR) and a listed functional gate metric (M-CONTAMINATION-RATE, inside functional_ok in spec.decision_rule) are structurally degenerate because unaffected_behavior uses out-of-support id='1'; the producer nevertheless marked the control pass=true and claimed H2 confirmed and all 14 gates passing. I verified independently that the scored raw artifact records contamination_n=0 and overbroad_contamination_n=0 on every trial (raw_evidence/runner_result_raw.json) while the prior packet's same control observed 4.0 on all three classes (codex/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-38197849043/result.json#controls.NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR); and that the runner helper does use literal id='1' (raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_reuse.py:623-639) against a documented support of ^1[0-9]{1}$ (spec.measurement_validity). Therefore the frozen classifier's functional_ok cannot be validly established and result.outcome=SUPPORTS is not adopted; the headline is measurement-invalid for the locality half. What survives auditing is bounded: the integer cost arithmetic recomputes exactly (audit.recomputed_metrics), the cold baseline is live and strong (1.0), the perturbation bites (literal 0.0), abstention is inert (no-repair 0.0), guard specificity holds (NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE stale=false), the treatment is functionally live (repair success 1.0, 12/12 per class, Wilson lower >=0.60), and the structural write set is localized (M-WRITE-SET-MAX=1). The audit's claim_ceiling explicitly bounds the justified result to the cost arithmetic on this substrate/counter plus the legacy reproduction, and explicitly excludes behavioural locality, counter-robustness, transfer, and any 'all gates pass' claim. Because the packet is partially measurement-invalid for its headline, v2 semantics require retaining the prior effective claim status: C-DELTA-REPAIR stays EXPERIMENTAL. No product promotion is possible (runtime lane; audit not PASS). continue=false because the next step (a corrected instrument and a counter-robustness test) requires a new frozen design and a new Global Research Director mandate; the frozen runner/prereg must not be rewritten, and the lane Director does not self-authorize.
